rationale: C06 is a highly plausible direct drafting template. It uses nearly identical recitals concerning federally acquired land-utilization-project lands, the same acquisition statutes, the same 1938 transfer as amended in 1940, administration under Title III of the Bankhead-Jones Farm Tenant Act, suitability for national-forest purposes, and the operative reservation of qualifying United States lands as national forest. The child adapts this concrete legal and administrative machinery from enlarging one forest in Utah to establishing three forests in Alabama, Georgia, and Mississippi. C17 and C18 share national-forest boundary and reservation mechanisms but lack C06's distinctive statutory and project-administration correspondence.

shared_material.parent_excerpt: certain lands...have been acquired by the United States under the authority of the Emergency Relief Appropriation Act of 1935...or Title III of the Bankhead-Jones Farm Tenant Act...for use in connection with the Central Utah Land Utilization Project
shared_material.explanation: Distinctive parallel recital identifying federal acquisition statutes and designated land-utilization projects.
